components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

## What I changed

The `bulkSignupWarning` value depends on a *count of other owners* (created today), so it can't be a pure derived getter like `getLocality()`/`getMembershipTier()` — those have no repository access. It has to be captured at creation and persisted, exactly like `namesakeCount`. I followed that existing pattern:

1. **New pipeline step** — `rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning.java`. Reuses the existing `Registrations.countOn(...)` helper (the same accumulation path the daily-limit rule uses, per the test's own note) to count owners already registered on the new owner's registration date, and sets the flag to `count > 80`. Runs after `BuildOwner` (entity + rolled registration date exist) and before `SaveOwner` (so the new owner isn't counted).

2. **Wired into** `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` as `assignBulkSignupWarning`, between `assignNamesakeCount` and `assignCustomerCode`, under the same `transaction` governance.

3. **`Owner` entity** — added a `bulk_signup_warning` boolean column with `isBulkSignupWarning()`/`setBulkSignupWarning()`.

4. **OpenAPI schema** (`openapi.yml`) — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gets the field and MapStruct maps it automatically (no mapper change needed).

5. **Schema DDL** — added `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` to all four `schema.sql` files (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres). The `NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` keeps seed rows (whose inserts list columns explicitly) and any legacy rows at `false`, matching the "otherwise false" requirement.

Each piece sits in its single-responsibility unit and reuses existing helpers rather than duplicating the counting logic.
